# Breez SDK - Spark: Swift

> End-to-end SDK for instant, non-custodial bitcoin and stablecoin payments. This edition carries every example in Swift, with identifiers in that language's naming convention. The same pages carrying all nine languages are under `/guide/`.

## About Breez SDK - Spark

- [About Breez SDK - Spark](/llms/swift/guide/about_breez_sdk_spark.md)
